lines.zh: 我的触须贴着墙往前探。
lines.en: My tendrils probe along the wall.

lines.zh: 被召来的我，喘得比同类细。
lines.en: Summoned, I breathe thinner than my kin.
Summoned, so I have to strike.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼睛闪着绿光。
lines.en: Fixing the player with green eyes.

lines.zh: 张开血盆大口，嘶嘶作响。
我低伏着身躯滑过石面。
lines.en: I slip low across the stone.

lines.zh: 我的触手扫过地面留湿痕。
lines.en: My tentacles sweep the floor, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我是被召来的，等得不久。
lines.en: I was summoned, so I haven't waited long.
Scanning the area, searching for food.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，仿佛思考猎物。
lines.en: Lowering head, seemingly thinking about prey.

lines.zh: 慢慢晃动身体，发出轻微声音。
lines.en: Gently moving, making a slight sound.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，显得非常警惕。
环视四周，警惕地嘶嘶作响。
被召唤的我，比原版轻一些。
lines.en: Summoned, I'm a bit lighter than the wild ones.

lines.zh: 轻微嘶嘶，仿佛在自言自语。
lines.en: Soft hiss, as if talking to itself.

lines.zh: 我听着洞穴深处的水滴。
lines.en: I listen to water dripping deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 我这具躯壳比同类更薄。
lines.en: This shell of mine is thinner than my kin's.

lines.zh: 召唤的烙印还亮在我胸口。
lines.en: The summoning brand still glows on my chest.

lines.zh: 召唤的火印还在胸口发烫。
lines.en: The summoning brand still burns on my chest.

lines.zh: 我的触须垂着，轻轻抽动。
lines.en: My tendrils hang and twitch faintly.
I listen to the echoes in the dark.
I curl up like a wet stone.
Raising head, locking onto the player.

lines.zh: 迅速转向玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Quickly turning to the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Locking target, emitting a low hiss声.

lines.zh: 眼睛发出绿光，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Emitting green light from eyes, fixing on the player.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，分辨你的气味。
lines.en: I tilt my neck, sorting out your scent.

lines.zh: 转头看向玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Turning head to the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，眼睛发出绿光。
lines.en: Emitting a hiss, eyes glowing green.
I scent the warmth of something alive.
My gaze crawls out of the dark.
My green light pauses on your face.
I tilt my body to study you.
A tendril of mine reaches out your way.
I slowly part my jaws wider.
I compare you with the offerings.

lines.zh: 呜咽声，仿佛灵魂被撕裂
lines.en: Sobbing, as if the soul is tearing

lines.zh: 虚弱的咆哮，生命之火微弱
lines.en: Weak roar, the life fire weakens

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声，仿佛魔力被耗尽
lines.en: Hissing, as if magic is drained

lines.zh: 嘶嘶响，它盯着你的眼睛。
lines.en: Sssss, it fixes its gaze on your eyes.

lines.zh: 被召唤出来，比同类更饿。
lines.en: Summoned, I'm hungrier than my kin.

lines.zh: 我的力量源自你的恐惧。
lines.en: My power comes from your fear.
Swallow you, merge with my might.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我的力量进入你。
lines.en: Come closer, let my power consume you.

lines.zh: 不要逃跑，我会追上你的。
lines.en: Do not run, I will catch you.

lines.zh: 你体内有我可以利用的能量。
lines.en: You have energy I can harness.

lines.zh: 品尝我的力量，你将感到满足。
lines.en: Taste my power, you will feel satisfied.

lines.zh: 撞击只会增强我的力量。
找一个伴侣，增强我们的力量。
lines.en: Find a mate, enhance our power.

lines.zh: 这具召唤出来的身子想找个同类。
lines.en: This summoned body wants one of its own kind.

lines.zh: 与我交配，增强你的力量。
lines.en: Mate with me, enhance your strength.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，吞噬者张开大口。
触须缠绕，吞噬者锁定目标。
发光体在吞噬者手中闪烁。
吞噬者吸食着腐烂的肉块。
触手缠绕，吞噬者撕裂猎物。
吞噬者发出震耳欲聋的叫声。
光点在吞噬者身上游走。
吞噬者舔舐着锋利的牙齿。
吞噬者围绕着发光体盘旋。
吞噬者发出低沉的嗡鸣。
吞噬者的触手伸向目标。
吞噬者释放出一道光芒。
lines.en: Devourer emits a beam of light.

lines.zh: 吞噬者散发出冷冽的光。

lines.en: The summoner never said to keep you alive.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经饿了很久。
lines.en: This body has been hungry a long while.

lines.zh: 我的触手分三路围过来。
lines.en: My tentacles close in from three sides.

lines.zh: 我的护盾贴着地面推近。
lines.en: My shield pushes forward along the floor.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音压低了。
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops lower.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到了前肢上。
lines.en: I shift my weight onto my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 吞下你的心脏，感受痛苦！
召唤阵的裂缝里，我挤出半个身子！
lines.en: I squeeze half my body out of the summoning rift!
Summon from the void, I come!
Devourer, you found the right place!
Gate to void, I open it!
Master of darkness, I am freed!
The edge of the summoning circle still burns.
I squeeze out of the carved sigil.

lines.zh: 虚空在墙角开了一道缝。
lines.en: The void opens a seam in the corner.

lines.zh: 被叫来的时候，我还没长全。

lines.en: Cold air fills the room first.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的躯体撕开几条口子。
lines.en: The blast splits several gashes in my body.
I've never had my fill since being summoned.
